page.overview:
Who is Alonne Frith?

Alonne Frith is a Hollow One and cultist of Ceratos.

Alonne hails from Rotthold in Blightshore, where he works as a scholar of the Far Realm. In 835 PD during the War of Ash and Light, Alonne traveled to Brokenveil Marsh find eldritch relics. While there, he was captured by the Righteous Brand soldiers stationed at Fort Venture, where his undead nature was noticed by the sadistic Inquisitor in charge, Parson Pellinost. Pelinost took interest in Alonne and had him imprisoned so he could be studied and experimented on.

When Bol'bara, another prisoner at Fort Venture, went on a rampage after becoming posessed by her shadow demon patron Trush, Alonne was left alone in his cage as the sole survivor. When the adventuring party hired to resuce Bol'bara arived, he descirbed to them how her powers caused the guards to turn against each other. If freed, Alonne could be convinced by the adventuring party to help find the possessed Bol'bara, but with difficulty.
